name: St Mary of the Annunciation, Littleborough

boundary.description: From the Rochdale - Rossendale District boundary near Brownhouse Wham Reservoir, N along that boundary to Hades Hill and then along Rochdale - Calderdale District boundary, across Warland Reservoir, crossing Turvin Road (B6138) and Halifax Road (A58) to M62 Motorway near junction 22. Then W along the motorway to Lower Booth Hollins Farm and by a bee-line across Hollingworth Lake to Smithy Bridge Road past the Smithy Bridge Railway Station to New Road, Halifax Road, Union Road. Then W by a beeline to the junction of Thimble Close and Birch Road, N along Birch Road to its junction with Ramsden Road and W by a beeline to Rochdale – Rossendale District boundary.
